category: Usenet indexer (movies and TV only, Newznab API on paid plans)

free_tier.stated: The Free plan is browsing, watchlist, collection and preferences only: 'No NZB downloads or Newznab API'. Downloads start at the Basic plan, USD 15.00 per year.
free_tier.notes: Paid plans: Basic USD 15 per year (3,000 API requests and 1,000 NZB downloads a day), Premium USD 20 (10,000 and 5,000), Ultra USD 30 (20,000 and 20,000).

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an NZB pointer file, never the payload

retention.stated: not stated on the pages read; the index covers movie and TV releases only

egress.terms: No byte metering; the plans meter NZB downloads and API requests per day.

interface_detail: A web app for browsing plus a Newznab API for apps on the paid plans, with the limits shared across the account's API keys.
tooling: The plans page states a Newznab API 'for your apps'; Prowlarr and NZBHydra2 add Newznab indexers with URL plus key, and the key sits behind a sign-up and a paid plan.
chaining: At USD 15 per year with 1,000 downloads a day it is a cheap paid escape for movie and TV grabs; the free plan alone retrieves nothing.

limits.value: Free plan: no NZB downloads and no Newznab API (0 per day); a yearly plan from USD 15 unlocks both
Basic plan: 3,000 API requests and 1,000 NZB downloads per day, shared across API keys

binding_note: The free plan's download counter is zero, so it binds before any paid counter; the vocabulary has no paywall term and request-rate is the nearest.

identity_cost.detail: The free sign-up form asks for a display name, an email address and a password of at least 12 characters. Paid plans are paid in Bitcoin through BTCPay with no automatic renewal, so no card is taken.

reliability_note: The service relaunched in May 2023 and was rebuilt as a new app; no outage was observed.
confidence_note: The plans page and the sign-up form are first-party text read; the paid counters were not exercised.
